description: This PHP class 'LangString' represents a data transfer object (DTO) used in the OrangeHRM system. It encapsulates language string data with properties such as unit ID, group ID, value, version, and note. It provides constructor and getter methods, and a static factory method for creating instances from an array.

classes.name: LangString
classes.description: A data transfer object (DTO) representing a language string with properties like unit ID, group ID, value, version, and note, with methods for instantiation and property access.

methods.name: getVersion
methods.description: Returns the version string or null.

methods.name: getNote
methods.description: Returns the note string or null.

methods.name: createFromArray
methods.description: Creates a new instance of LangString from an associative array.
